# Jagmohan Sawmill

> Jebodh Jagmohan and Company LTD, known as Jagmohan Sawmill, supplies lumber, materials and site services in Trinidad & Tobago.

## Business information

- Address: J. Jagmohan & Co. Ltd, 331 Rochard Rd, Penal, Trinidad & Tobago.
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00am to 4:00pm. Closed Sundays.
- Displayed prices are in Trinidad and Tobago dollars (TTD) and include VAT. Confirm current prices and availability with the business.

## Website pages

- [Home](/): Business overview, capabilities and common questions.
- [Lumber](/lumber): Timber types, mouldings, pallets and export timber.
- [Tools](/products): Bandsaw blades, sharpening supplies, welding electrodes, pneumatic coil nailers, coil nails and loose nails.
- [Concrete sleepers](/steel): Sale and rental enquiries.
- [Services](/services): White plastering sand, haulage, trailer haulage, tree removal and sawmill services.
- [Trailer haulage](/services#trailer-haulage): Low Boy, Step Deck and Goose Neck options. Enquire with load dimensions, weight, pickup and destination.
- [Contact](/contact): Current staff contacts, opening hours, address and directions.
- [Request a quote](/quote): Send quantities, sizes or service requirements for pricing and availability.
